gaps.root_cause: C2 float/rounding: Core quantizes fee and tax to 0.01 (HALF_UP/UP/DOWN only); convention v1 §1.6 is unrounded Decimal, so any fee/tax with more than 2 decimals differs and the difference propagates into realized PnL
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: add rounding mode 'NONE' to CostProfile.fee_rounding/tax_rounding (skip _round) and carry fees/taxes as Decimal in calculate_costs; keep HALF_UP for real-market profiles

gaps.root_cause: K15 rejection log: Core appends one rejection per UNFILLED order (final reason) and none for bars skipped by an order that fills later; convention v1 §1.4 logs one rejection per skipped bar with bar_ts
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: in ExecutionEngine.run, inside the candidate loop, append {order_id, bar_ts=bar_start, reason} for every bar skipped with a rejection reason (OUTSIDE_SESSION, ZERO_VOLUME_BAR, side-ineligible, exclusion) whether or not the order fills later

gaps.root_cause: K14 TIF: Core DAY restricts candidates to the session of the FIRST candidate bar; convention v1 §1.5 keeps the order until the end of the first session whose end > order_ts
gaps.code_location: src/market_research_core/execution.py: DAY branch (`candidates[candidates['session_open'] == first_session_open]`) and ExecutionOrder.time_in_force Literal
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: add TIF 'UNTIL_END_OF_NEXT_SESSION_END' (or align DAY) computing expiry from session_close > order_time and emit ORDER_EXPIRED at that time

cases: probe X03_chronology (no oracle answer; invariant exit_ts >= entry_ts)
gaps.expected: round trips with exit_ts >= entry_ts; state updated in fill-time order
gaps.root_cause: C3: ExecutionEngine.run processes orders sequentially by order_time and searches each order's fill independently; a later order can fill EARLIER than a pending earlier order, but FIFO/cash/target state are updated in order_time sequence, producing round trips with exit before entry
gaps.code_location: src/market_research_core/execution.py: `orders = sorted(...)` + per-order candidate search + immediate FIFO/cash/target_positions update
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: event-driven loop over bar_start: at each bar, evaluate all live orders (order_time <= bar_start) in order_time sequence and apply fills to cash/FIFO/target state immediately, so state always follows fill time
